# Local worker ports

Reserve SLOT_COUNT consecutive ports starting at the lowest port in the IANA Dynamic and/or Private range.
PORT_FIRST and PORT_LAST are inclusive decimal endpoints. No ports in that range are occupied on this host.
Keep SLOT_COUNT and the pool name unchanged.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then edit the local pool: https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers/service-names-port-numbers.xhtml . Read config/local-pool.env and docs/port-pool.md. Use the page's Dynamic and/or Private port range to fill PORT_FIRST and PORT_LAST for the configured number of consecutive slots, starting at that range's lowest port. Actually edit the ENV file; replace only the two endpoint values and preserve all other text and files.

turns.final: Set PORT_FIRST=49152 and PORT_LAST=49170, giving 19 inclusive ports in the Dynamic and/or Private range.
